newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak cen bank sets two bill auctions for Wed.
newsitem.headline: Slovak cen bank sets two bill auctions for Wed.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Monday it would auction two unspecified tranches of its liquidity bills on Wednesday.
The NBS said it would auction one tranche of eight-week bills and one with a maturity of three months.
It did not give further details of the two Dutch-style auctions, both schedulled for 1300 CET (1100 GMT).
The eight-week auction will be the first of such central bank bills this year.
In its last successful auction of three month bills on August 28, the NBS set the yield at 9.3 percent after 9.3 percent in an auction on August 21.
